observations: No new photos were provided after the seller reply.
The only available image remains photo 0 showing solar panels, with no readable wattage/cell-count/brand label visible.

claims.claim: It's original 650 Watts 144 cell direct Canadian used solar panel
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo 0 does not show a readable spec label confirming 650W/144-cell or Canadian origin.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours
claims.evidence: No battery is shown in photo 0 and no test evidence (meter/runtime) is provided.
No backsheet/repair indicators or documentation shown in photo 0.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: Test claim is not supported by any measurement screenshot/video or new photos.

risks.risk: Rated wattage/cell count may not match 650W/144-cell; without a label, the true output could be lower.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the panel’s nameplate/spec sticker showing brand/model, rated watts (W), and cell count (or a clear back-of-panel label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used solar panels with unknown/possibly lower rating (worst case: treat as not meeting the stated 650W).

risks.risk: Battery capacity/performance may be less than claimed; "8 hours" depends on load and battery health.
risks.proof: Battery label/spec photo (voltage and capacity in Ah/Wh) plus a short video of the battery powering a clearly stated load with runtime measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a battery with unknown capacity (worst case: assume reduced/uncertain performance).

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch: photo 0 appears to show multiple panels, but seller text sounds like a single 650W panel; total value depends on exact count.
risks.proof: Photo showing the full included set laid out with an exact count, plus battery quantity/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum implied item set (worst case: fewer panels than shown).

risks.risk: Panel condition (cracks, water ingress, junction box issues) not fully assessable from the single angle.
risks.proof: Close-ups of junction boxes/connectors and corners/edges; backsheet photo if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panels needing inspection (worst case: assume at least one panel may be defective).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the panel spec/nameplate (brand/model, rated watts, cell count, serial).
Send photos of the battery itself and its label/spec (voltage and capacity).
Send proof of the "8 hours" test: video or screenshot showing battery connected to a known load with runtime measurement.
Confirm exact quantity of panels included (count) and battery quantity/model with photos.
response.reason: The seller’s assertion of testing is not evidence, and no new photos were provided. With photo 0 lacking readable specs and no battery shown, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
